styles.name: Swiss Grid

signature.color_and_material: Warm paper, near-black text, one red signal and hairline dividers.
signature.composition: Twelve-column alignment, oversized flush-left type and numbered horizontal divisions.
signature.content_rhythm: Long ruled service rows in A; staggered project fields and a colophon in B.
signature.imagery: Original CSS typographic studies instead of dependent photography.
signature.interaction: Underlined text links, offset focus rings and native details disclosures.
signature.motion: Only brief link-color changes; reduced motion removes transitions.
signature.navigation: A visible compact numbered index; no hidden mobile drawer.
signature.typography: One sans-serif family with abrupt scale changes and tight display tracking.

styles.summary: Numbered typographic grids, oversized alignment and precise service or portfolio indexes.
